Subject: Private deployment architecture review request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the conversation today. We're planning a private deployment evaluation for ACME's regulated workloads and would like a technical deep-dive to cover VPC networking, on-prem options, and air-gapped requirements.

Primary goals:
- Validate networking and egress controls (VPC peering, NAT, endpoints)
- Understand on-prem bundle and hardware/OS recommendations
- Discuss KMS/HSM integrations and audit logging for SOC2
- Clarify data-at-rest/in-transit controls and support for air-gapped installs

Proposed attendees on our side: myself (Sam), Marta Lopez (infrastructure lead), and our security architect (TBD).

Are you able to run a 60–90 minute architecture review next week? Our preferred windows (PST):
- Tue 3/10 09:00–11:00 or
- Wed 3/11 13:00–16:00

If those don't work, we can shift. Also happy to share a network diagram in advance — please let us know what level of detail you need.

Thanks,

Hi Sam —

Thanks for the clear list. We can definitely run through those items. Proposed plan: 75 minute session (45 min presentation + 30 min Q&A/next steps). We'll cover: runtime topology (KV cache, batching considerations), networking (VPC peering, private endpoints), on-prem packaging/OS & hardware guidance, KMS/HSM options, and the air-gapped install checklist.

I can host Tue 3/10 at 10:00 PST which fits your window. Vivek (SE) will cover the on-prem packaging and quantization implications; Neha (security) will cover KMS/HSM and audit logs. Dev will join for deployment APIs and config.

Please confirm whether Tue 3/10 10:00–11:15 PST works and share a network diagram (simple CIDR ranges + existing firewalls/NAT). If you'd prefer Wed, flag that.

I'll send a calendar invite once we confirm and include a short pre-read (checklist + topology draft).

Best,

Sam / team —

10:00 PST on Tue 3/10 works for me. A couple of asks to make the session productive:

1) Please attach a one-page network diagram (CIDRs, firewalls, any transit gateways) and existing VPN/VPC peering details.
2) If you plan an air-gapped install, flag whether hardware is already air-gapped (no external connectivity) or if you expect a controlled transfer station. That changes offline package delivery steps.
3) KMS: are you evaluating a cloud-managed KMS + HSM or on-prem HSMs? If on-prem HSM, tell us vendor/model if available.

I'll prepare slides for on-prem bundle, expected OS/kernel versions we validate, and the recommended hardware footprint per concurrent session.

Thanks — quick update: our security architect had a conflict and requested we push the session by one day to Wed 3/11 so the full infra/security team can attend. Apologies for the late change. New proposed time: Wed 3/11 14:00–15:15 PST.

We will share a light network diagram this afternoon. For the HSM question: we're leaning toward a managed HSM via our cloud provider for the PoC, but evaluating on-prem HSMs for long-term. I'll confirm vendor info before the meeting.

Also — can you share an air-gapped install checklist? Specifically: required package sizes, preferred transfer methods, and verification steps (signatures/checksums). If you have a template, that would save us time.

On Wed we plan to have Sam, Marta, and our security architect (Michael Reynolds) on the call.

—Sam
